copysectionin.title: Sunflower Keys — Copy a chosen section inward as an earlier answer
copysectionin.message: an inward section copy precedes its original colors and is one silent reversible drawing edit

copy.edit-note-range-copy-in-help: Insert a copy twenty-five seeds inward just before the chosen section. Note colors and the section’s order stay the same. If any destination is held or outside the garden, nothing is copied. Undo restores the drawing.
